common.appName.description: The app's short name, in the browser tab and on top of the join screen.

common.you.description: Small chip next to the name of the player who uses this device, in player lists.

common.host.description: Shown instead of a player name when this device belongs to the person running the game.

common.watching.description: Shown instead of a player name when this device only watches the game (a spectator).

common.grandPrize.description: The final, hardest question of a game, asked when a player reaches the finish. Used like a category name.

common.reconnecting.description: Notice while the device has lost its connection to the server and tries again on its own.

common.language.description: Label of the menu that picks the language of the app on this device.

common.languageAuto.description: First option of the language menu: follow the game's (or organization's) language instead of a fixed choice.

placeholders.language: The language that would be used, in its own name, e.g. Español

common.gameOver.description: Heading when a game has ended.

common.draw.description: The game ended without a winner: several players tied when the round limit was reached.

common.endedByHost.source: The host ended the game before anyone won.

common.winsExclaim.description: Announces the winner of the game.

board.space.start.description: Type of board space: where every player begins.

board.space.category.description: Type of board space: landing on it asks a question of its category.

board.space.hq.description: Type of board space: a category's headquarters. A correct answer there wins the category's token. Usually kept as the abbreviation HQ.

board.space.wildcard.description: Type of board space: the player picks any category for their question.

board.space.roll_again.description: Type of board space: the player rolls the die once more.

board.space.penalty.description: Type of board space (a penalty): the player misses their next turn.

board.space.finish.description: Type of board space: the end of a linear track. Reaching it earns the Grand Prize question.

board.tile.start.description: Written in capitals inside the Start space on the board drawing. Very little room.

board.tile.finish.description: Written in capitals inside the Finish space on the board drawing. Very little room.

board.tile.roll_again.description: Written inside the Roll again space on the board drawing, in capitals on two lines (keep the line break). At most ~7 letters per line.

board.tile.penalty.description: Written inside the penalty space (miss your next turn) on the board drawing, in capitals on two lines (keep the line break). At most ~7 letters per line.

board.tile.wildcard.description: Written inside the Wildcard space on the board drawing (the player picks any category). Very little room.

board.tile.hq.description: Written inside a category's headquarters space on the board drawing, above the category name. Keep the star.

board.win.finish.description: A way to win the game: reach the last space and answer the Grand Prize question.

board.win.collection.description: A way to win the game: win the token of every category (at their HQ spaces).

board.win.turn_limit.description: A way to win the game: have the best score when the last round ends.

board.result.correct.description: Result of an answer, in lower case after “Last answer:”.

board.result.incorrect.description: Result of an answer, in lower case after “Last answer:”.

board.result.timeout.description: Result of an answer when the timer ran out, in lower case after “Last answer:”.
